tvShow.name: The Boroughs
tvShow.overview: In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a crew of unlikely heroes must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time.

episodes.name: Welcome to The Boroughs
episodes.overview: When grieving widower Sam Cooper reluctantly moves to a desert retirement community, he discovers something lurking beneath its perfect surface.

episodes.name: The Mourning After
episodes.overview: Still reeling, Sam seeks answers close to home. Renee gets a break in the case of the missing minerals. Judy and Wally face up to painful realities.

episodes.name: A Pyramid
episodes.overview: Sam and Wally decide to take a risk. Renee and Paz's investigation brings them closer together. Art seeks answers in the desert.

episodes.name: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.overview: Art savors the fruits of his explorations. Blaine warns Sam that curiosity comes with consequences. Renee makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: Another Beautiful Day
episodes.overview: Sam, Judy and Wally uncover a new side of The Boroughs. Renee and Paz go on a road trip. Blaine tries to convince Claire to take action.

episodes.name: The Grey Rebellion
episodes.overview: With the entire gang under Blaine's thumb, Sam desperately seeks a way out. Art and Judy hit a breaking point. Wally gets a taste of a new life.

episodes.name: Time to Go
episodes.overview: As the anniversary party approaches, Anneliese reveals a painful secret. The gang gets in gear for a high-stakes rescue mission at The Manor.

episodes.name: Triple Audible
episodes.overview: With Blaine and Anneliese desperate to capture Mother, Sam and his friends put it all on the line to save their neighbors and set things right.

reviews.author: tender_buttkiss
reviews.content: Terrible ham fisted acting. Just an absolute waste of time. Had some score that made it feel like I was watching a Spielberg film, real hopeful music, plus the sci-fi premise seemed roght up my alley, but between the god awful acting and the shitty cgi monster, there wasn't enough to keep me watching. Waste of time.

reviews.author: Sejian
reviews.content:
I enjoyed this up until the very end.

**[SPOILERS AHEAD]**

The final episode got so predictable that it pulled me out of the show.

Anneliese stabs Judy and of course they drag her along to the trap house "in case they need a bargaining chip". Then she dies in the same room as Mother and... Why not just have Mother heal her before she dies?

By the time we get to this scene, we all know Mother's blood heals. They do some arse-covering by showing that Mother's blood isn't healing Anneliese's gunshot wound quickly, but that doesn't mean it wasn't doing anything.

Furthermore, Sam could have simply asked Mother if there was anything she could do BEFORE JUDY DIED. Instead we get this drawn out scene of Judy dying, just for Mother to resurrect her, which I'm gonna assume we all assumed was gonna happen!

Everyone's just standing around watching Judy die and no one asks Mother, "Hey, can you help her?". REALLY?!

Then there's Blaine.

It's like the creators of this show don't realize their audience includes people who have seen hundreds if not thousands of scenes like this.

Was I really supposed to think that Blaine was dead and be pikachu shocked when he wasn't dead?

Was that a Duffer Brothers special?

SMH.

T'was a somewhat disappointing final episode to an otherwise good first season.

reviews.author: tmdb53838703
reviews.content: Despite the engaging first few episodes, you'll understand by the end that you have watched lame euthanasia commercial in 8 episodes.

reviews.author: astroboudicca
reviews.content: If you're going to watch this show chiefly for sci-fi/action of course you're going to be disappointed. There were so many themes and messages that you'd overlook. This was a really heartwarming story where everyone has their moment to shine, all characters are likeable, and the story focuses on older folks as the heros without making being old the butt of a joke.
